Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Hema - 34 years, mother
Look: yellow kurta, jeans

Places

1. The living room - a sofa, a table, a big window
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches
3. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant

Scene 1: The living room - Day

[Ishaan stands in the living room. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "Today feels like a good day."

[Ishaan eats his breakfast at the table.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan takes a bite of his sandwich.]

Ishaan: "One more time!"

[Ishaan munches on an apple.]

Ishaan (happily): "What happened?"

[Ishaan drinks a glass of water.]

Hema: "That's great!"

[Ishaan serves hot rotis to Mother.]

Ishaan: "Mom, listen!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan catches the ball.]

Ishaan: "What next?"

[Ishaan kicks the football hard.]

Hema (surprised): "And then?"

[Ishaan swings on the swing.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

[Ishaan goes down the slide.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan plays on the see-saw with Mother.]

Ishaan (gently): "This is amazing!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[Ishaan stands in the courtyard. Hema stands near him.]

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan helps Mother get up.]

Ishaan: "I knew it!"

[A flock of birds flies across the sky.]

Ishaan: "That was fun!"

Scene 4: The park - Day

Hema: "What a nice place."

[Ishaan goes jogging in the park.]

Ishaan: "Mom, look at this."

[Ishaan kicks the football hard.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan plays cricket in the park.]

Ishaan: "I really enjoyed today."
